name: pojun
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG walking SPRITE SHEET, not concept art.
Output a single transparent PNG sheet at 2048 x 1024 pixels, EXACTLY 8 columns by 4 rows, all 32 cells equal 256x256 pixels. NO visible grid lines, NO labels, NO text. Artwork must leave clear transparent gaps between cells. Each full character with weapon completely inside its own cell, never overlaps neighboring cells.
Use the supplied image ONLY as this character's identity/clothes/color reference. Redraw at small practical 16-bit RPG game sprite scale, modest chibi proportions, crisp pixel clusters, readable silhouettes, fixed lighting and palette. Same body size and outfit in all 32 poses. Full standing body approximately 200 pixels tall within each 256 cell, torso center at x128; grounding/ankle midpoint at x128, ground baseline y232. At least 12 pixels clear on all cell edges. Camera slightly elevated orthographic top-down RPG, no floor, no scene, actual transparent alpha background, no baked checkerboard.
ROW ORDER mandatory top to bottom:
ROW 1 (y0..255): DOWN south, walking toward viewer, true FRONT torso and face toward bottom of screen in ALL eight cells.
ROW 2 (y256..511): LEFT west, true LEFT-FACING SIDE profile with nose facing screen-left in ALL eight cells.
ROW 3 (y512..767): RIGHT east, true RIGHT-FACING SIDE profile with nose facing screen-right in ALL eight cells.
ROW 4 (y768..1023): UP north, walking away, true BACK view in ALL eight cells; show back of head/hair, back of clothing; NO eyes/face/chest in this row.
Across EVERY row left to right is one full continuous 8-phase natural human WALK cycle, not attacks, not running and not eight copies of a static stance:
col0 LEFT leg reaches forward/contact, RIGHT leg trails; col1 left foot planted, body lowers a little and right heel lifts; col2 left leg supports and RIGHT foot passes beneath pelvis with knee visibly bent; col3 right leg swings forward nearing contact while left heel rises;
col4 RIGHT leg reaches forward/contact, LEFT leg trails, opposite leg configuration from col0; col5 right foot planted and left heel lifts; col6 right leg supports and LEFT foot passes under pelvis bent; col7 left leg swings forward nearing contact, ready to loop seamlessly into col0.
Change the actual leg joint/foot poses, with opposing subtle arm swing, shoulders stay level, only 2-4 pixels of torso bob, natural weight transfer. Side-view feet MUST have clear alternating long-short stride and bent passing legs. Front/back feet also exchange which foot extends forward; the ankles and hems change rather than cloning a rigid pose. Head, pelvis and torso registration fixed per cell; character never travels across its cell. Cloak, skirt and hair trail with restrained secondary motion. Two legs, two feet, two arms, weapon attached consistently, no extra limbs. Preserve RIGHT-HAND weapon grip across all views; no arbitrary hand switching, no horizontal mirroring that swaps handedness. No out-of-cell blades/capes, no changing character design/height, no turning within a row, no spinning, no disappearing limbs.
Character: POJUN / 破军. Middle-aged bearded male warrior, short brown hair, rugged face, dark red heavy armor with warm gold trim and beast-head shoulder plates, dark red cloak, metal boots. Large greatsword securely sheathed diagonally across his BACK throughout the walk, same sword design as identity reference, blade and handle never teleport; both arms free for restrained arm swing. Heavy controlled walking gait, both boots fully visible. Do not draw attack poses.
